Here, we just take the constant out of the derivative and use the result for the derivative of $\csc x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2\operatorname{csc}⁡x) \\  & =2\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{csc}⁡x) \\  & =2(-\operatorname{csc}⁡x\operatorname{cot}⁡x) \\  & =-2\operatorname{csc}⁡x\operatorname{cot}⁡x\end{aligned}
$$
